featured_reviews.review_text:
No CrossFit and Functional equipments.

Few months back in this year 2025, I visited this gym. With loads of excitement, I was looking forward to join this gym. Because I had seen this gym somewhere around end of 2021-22, and this gym looked so lively and of positive vibes back then. And also had CrossFit area below the gym where now they have a restaurant. Now after the recent visit, I’m highly disappointed. Although gym is well maintained, good big changing room with mirror & lockers and also having all weight training equipment. All machines looked new & very beginners level. They had better machines earlier. Also there is no circuit training floor. No crossfit standalone rig. Such a big reputed gym no functional equipment like big truck tire, Sledgehammer, CrossFit standalone rig, battle rope. Having only cardio and weight machines is very common in every gym even in basic old gyms around . I was in Slimwell gym earlier , even they had all above mentioned stuff at just 10k year. This gym charges 20k-25k for just basic gym equipments. Which also I was ready to pay but where is the uniqueness and no CrossFit area. This was highly upsetting & disappointing. Big NO for now. Atleast deliver as per your gym rates. This gym looks 5/5 , but total waste and incomplete. It’s 2/5 now. All that glitters is not gold. You’ll have degraded your own gym standards. Upgrade smartly before it’s too late. Hope to join you’ll soon after upgradation.

There’s a good range of machines and enough space, so it never feels cramped. The staff is also quite welcoming and supportive, which makes it easier to stay consistent. Mahesh sir has been very supportive as my trainer and has helped me stay focused throughout progress. Overall, a great place to build your fitness journey!

featured_reviews.name: Shubhata Joijode
featured_reviews.review_text: Spacious gym with advanced equipment, a great crowd, and totally value for money. The trainers are excellent, especially Sagar Salvi. I’ve been training with him for almost two years now and honestly can’t go back to normal workouts. He’s knowledgeable, kind, and always brings innovative routines. My immunity and overall health has improved significantly.

featured_reviews.name: Trupti Dingoria
featured_reviews.review_text: Joined this gym 3 months ago and really happy with the experience. Great equipment, positive atmosphere, and friendly vibes. Special thanks to my Personal Trainer Mr. Updesh for the excellent guidance and motivation throughout. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: kee pho
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pros: The facility itself is fantastic. It’s spacious, clean, and the equipment is top-tier. Definitely one of the better-equipped gyms in the area.

​Cons: The gym culture is becoming an issue. There are too many people treating the floor like a private film studio. Tripods are everywhere, and some members are quite rude if you walk into "their shot." It’s a shared space, not a content house. I’d love to give this 5 stars, but the lack of discipline regarding filming makes it a frustrating place to actually work out

featured_reviews.name: Chinmay Ayare
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve been going to Smart Flex regularly for quite some time now, and it has genuinely become an important part of my daily routine. The atmosphere is energetic and motivating, which makes it easier to stay consistent with workouts.The equipment at Smart Flex is well-maintained and offers a great variety, whether you’re into strength training, cardio, or functional fitness.

featured_reviews.name: Royal Rajput
featured_reviews.review_text:
Been a member of this gym since it started and for over 6 years now. Gym is good, good in terms of space but for the past 6 months horrible crowd in the evenings gets super crowded. Group workouts are common hence you don't get equipment. Crowd quality is not good at all.
Another point is they have no loyalty for old members. Same price for old members renewal and new members. Their membership fees keep changing. Membership prices are as per their whims and fancy. They are not concerned about the members and dosent matter to them if you leave the gym. In my 30 years of working out, first gym I came across like this. Definitely not renewing my membership here. 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏

featured_reviews.name: Abdulrehman Javed Qureshi
featured_reviews.review_text: I've been going to this gym for a few months now, and I’m genuinely impressed. The facility is clean, well-maintained, and equipped with a wide range of machines and free weights. There's something for everyone – whether you're into strength training, cardio. The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and always ready to help or answer questions. The trainers are professional and motivational, offering helpful tips without being pushy. I also appreciate how welcoming the environment is – it's not intimidating, even for beginners.

featured_reviews.name: Aayat Choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text: I’m new to working out, and this gym has been great. The trainers are patient, the staff is friendly, and the whole environment feels welcoming. The facilities are clean, there’s plenty of equipment, and I always get a good workout here. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Iqra Qureshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Friendly & knowledgeable staff and trainers a clean well maintained space with quality equipments.I’ve seen incredible results thanks to the amazing staff.From cardio to strength training everything is well & supported.Big shoutout to the trainers for making fitness fun & helping me reach goals I didn’t think were possible.

featured_reviews.name: Yogita Randive
featured_reviews.review_text: It’s been a year at  Forever Fitness gym and I’m really happy with the results! My strength, fitness, and overall health have all improved significantly. The gym has a great range of equipment, awesome classes, and a motivating atmosphere. The staff is supportive, and I always feel challenged. Definitely a place that delivers real results!

featured_reviews.name: Omkar Pradne
featured_reviews.review_text: The trainer is amazing—knowledgeable, patient, and always ready to adjust workouts to my goals. I’ve learned proper form and feel stronger every session. Best guidance I’ve had in any gym

featured_reviews.name: Soul Secret
featured_reviews.review_text: Forever Fit is an excellent gym with top-quality equipment, a clean and spacious environment, and a motivating atmosphere. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, always ready to help. With great classes and well-maintained machines, it’s perfect for all fitness levels.

featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent gym with best equipment and best trainers and also pocket friendly 👍🏻👍🏻go for it guys

featured_reviews.name: Tanvija Kambli
featured_reviews.review_text: Very nice gym and all equipments are best and comfortable even the trainers are sweet and supportive to every one ❤️
